what_this_is: The first mechanically derived eligible-event count for HYP-04. Joins the anchor calendar, the anchor shocks, the curated linkage map and the collected peer closes through pair_eligibility.
what_this_is_not: Evidence about supply-chain transmission, and not a freeze. No target value, beta_h, horizon or direction has been computed. A count of data availability is publishable under the display-gate convention; what it implies is not.
unit_basis: Registry v1.11: 'Peer-side price data availability is a MEASURABILITY question, reported per pair. It is never a MEMBERSHIP question.' Registered 2026-09-02, before this assembler existed.

denial_note.why: a shockless event generates one denied pair per curated edge on its anchor, so an anchor with three edges contributes three; the counts are not interchangeable

per_peer_scoping.note: the per-peer unit's answer depends on which events it ranges over; both scopings are published so the choice is visible

reconciliation.question: registry v1.11 section 10: the assumed-price route and the real-coverage route agree numerically but were not shown to be the same event set
reconciliation.resolved: the two routes differ by exactly the events listed above, each identified with the peer whose coverage window is empty; the discrepancy is no longer a bare count difference

opens_no_gate: The display gate is CLOSED, C4 MET, four denials. This artifact supplies the count C2 asks for; it does not supply the freeze C3 asks for, and C2 and C3 move together or not at all.
